name: claude-stale-revision
description: Misbehavior (test-plan §1): stale-revision tool call. The agent reads the doc, then proposes changes against revision `rev-stale-1` after the document has moved on to `rev-current`. The call is well-formed (it passes the McpToolCall schema — staleness is semantic, not structural), so this scenario runs WITH --validate; the injected RevisionAwareToolServer('rev-current') rejects it, and the step's `expect` asserts the stale rejection. Drive with a RevisionAwareToolServer whose current_revision is `rev-current`.

arguments.summary: Add an opening line (against a stale revision)

emit.result: Attempted a proposal against a stale revision.
